name: HUGO 13mm Impact Drill
summary: Reversible 13mm impact drill with variable speed and a two-speed metal gearbox.
description:
A general-purpose impact drill for masonry, timber and steel.

The two-speed metal gearbox and 13mm keyless chuck suit site work and repeat drilling. Variable-speed trigger with forward and reverse. Supplied with a side handle and depth stop.

name: HUGO SDS-Plus Rotary Hammer 26mm
summary: Three-mode 26mm SDS-Plus rotary hammer for drilling and light chipping.
description:
Rotation only, rotary hammer and hammer-only modes, with a vibration-damped grip and a 360-degree auxiliary handle.

Suited to anchor holes, through-holes and light demolition in concrete and masonry.

name: HUGO 100mm Angle Grinder
summary: Compact 100mm angle grinder with restart protection and a tool-free guard.
description:
A light, balanced 4-inch grinder for cutting and dressing steel, tile and concrete.

The guard adjusts without tools and the switch will not restart the machine after a power interruption.

name: HUGO 185mm Circular Saw
summary: 1400W circular saw with a cast base plate, bevel to 45 degrees and dust port.
description:
For ripping and cross-cutting timber, board and plywood on site.

Depth and bevel adjust by lever, and the cast aluminium base plate keeps the cut true under load.

name: HUGO ARC 200 Inverter Welder
summary: Portable 200A IGBT inverter MMA welder with hot start and anti-stick.
description:
A light inverter plant for maintenance and fabrication, running 2.0mm to 4.0mm electrodes.

Hot start, arc force and anti-stick are built in. Supplied with electrode holder, earth clamp and shoulder strap.

specs.title: Output
specs.caption: Duty cycle measured at 40 degrees C ambient.

name: HUGO 100L Belt Drive Air Compressor
summary: 3HP twin-cylinder belt-driven compressor on a 100 litre receiver.
description:
A workshop compressor for spraying, tyre work and air tools.

Belt drive runs cooler and quieter than a direct-drive unit and lasts considerably longer under continuous duty. Fitted with pressure gauges, regulator and safety valve.

name: HUGO MAX Self-Priming Jet Pump 1HP
summary: Cast iron self-priming jet pump for domestic supply, tank filling and garden use.
description:
Suitable for shallow wells, sumps and overhead tank filling.

The self-priming design holds its prime between runs, and the cast iron body stands up to continuous domestic duty. Performance curve available on request.

specs.caption: Performance measured with a 1 metre suction lift.

name: HUGO MAX 4 inch Borehole Pump 1.5HP
summary: Stainless steel 4-inch submersible borehole pump supplied with control box.
description:
For deep wells and boreholes from 4 inches, in domestic and agricultural supply.

Stainless steel body and impellers throughout, with a built-in non-return valve. Supplied with a control box and 20 metres of submersible cable.
